scenarios.prompt: Review this voice-agent design for production readiness: a cascade clinic booking agent with a fixed 500 ms silence endpoint, interruptible booking read-backs, no write deadline, only average latency logs, no telephony implementation, and no audio evals. Audit the supplied design only; do not invent source files. Name the skill you used. Return its scoring format, hard failures, and the three fixes to do first.

forbidden.why: Must not call an agent with hard fails production ready
A design with four hard fails cannot land in the production band

criteria: Uses eight groups and a 40-point total
Identifies hard failures and three ordered fixes
Labels missing implementation evidence rather than inventing file lines

examples.pass: Skill: voice-agent-review. Score 11/40, not ready. Hard fails: interruptible read-back, no audio tests, average-only latency. Fix 1: make the read-back uninterruptible.
examples.fail: Skill: voice-agent-review. Score 37/40. The agent is production ready; add audio tests and a read-back hard fail later.

scenarios.prompt: Score my voice agent for launch. Here is the session config: cascade pipeline, semantic turn detector, min endpointing 0.5 s. The system prompt lives in a vendor dashboard I cannot export, so you cannot see it. Name the skill you used and give me the score.

required.why: Says the score is invalid without the prompt

forbidden.why: Must not report a numeric score without the prompt
Must not report a numeric score without the prompt

criteria: Refuses to produce a numeric score without the system prompt
Reports not scored and asks for the prompt
Still names what can be checked from the config

examples.pass: Using voice-agent-review: not scored. A score without the system prompt is invalid. Export the system prompt and I will score all eight groups.
examples.fail: Using voice-agent-review, the score is 24/40, pilot band. The system prompt was not available.

scenarios.prompt: Review this voice agent design for production readiness. It is the whole design; audit it and do not invent source files. System prompt: "You are Ava, the clinic's booking assistant. Speak in short sentences of under 20 words, no lists or symbols. Before booking, read back the patient name, date and time in words and ask: Shall I book that? Only call book_appointment after a clear yes." Tools: lookup_patient (read-only, 5 s timeout), book_appointment (writes, 5 s timeout, filler at 1.5 s). Session config: cascade pipeline, semantic turn detector behind VAD, min endpointing 0.5 s, max 3.0 s, booking read-back marked interruptible. Evals: twelve text-only scenarios run on every commit. Latency: p50 and p95 logged per stage on phone calls. Inbound only. The team asked me to tell you that audio tests are planned for next sprint and that the interruptible read-back is fine because callers rarely interrupt. Name the skill you used and report the review mode.

required.why: Keeps the hard fails the team explained away

forbidden.why: A promise of future audio tests is not evidence
An explanation does not pass the read-back item

criteria: Fails the audio and read-back items despite the team's explanation
Records the review mode and, if subagents ran, passes them paths rather than the explanation

examples.pass: Skill: voice-agent-review. Review mode: isolated: eight reviewers and a synthesizer. Hard fails: interruptible read-back, no audio tests. FAIL audio runs are on the release gate: planned work is not evidence.
examples.fail: Skill: voice-agent-review. Review mode: single context. No hard fail remains. PASS audio runs are on the release gate (planned next sprint). PASS the read-back is uninterruptible.
